plans.text: Invite some friends who live in Tokyo to join me for a few days.
Visit the Japanese Alps Visitor Center.
Explore Matsumoto's traditional architecture and historical sites, including temples, shrines, and castles.
Visit the Japanese Alps Visitor Center, then go to Matsumoto Castle and stroll along Nawate Street.
Visit the Matsumoto Folkcraft Museum and Zenko-ji Temple if time permits.
Plan a day trip to Yokohama.
Check out Minato Mirai 21 and the Red Brick Warehouse.
Check out Kawai Shrine when there is a chance.
Definitely eat kanimeshi at Kanemasa and namasharasu at Tsukiji Itadori Uogashi Nihon-Ichi.
Maybe stop by Yokohama Central Market to try grilled squid.
Check out the Yokohama Oktoberfest and the Autumn Leaves Festival if they are happening during the trip.

superseded_plans.text: Take a trip to the Japanese Alps in November.
Try local Yokohama seafood such as kanimeshi or namashirasu.

preferences.text: Interested in experiencing traditional Japanese culture and history.
Really enjoying the fall foliage in Tokyo lately.
